title: Rocco ad B (test): can your 4-year-old read this?

scenes.text: Splat! Rocco lands in the mud.
scenes.say: Can your four year old read this? Let's try!
Splat! Rocco lands in the mud.
He tries again. Bounce! A bit higher!
He flies high up in the sky!

scenes.small: one easy sentence on every page
scenes.say: Every page has one big picture to color, and one short sentence in big, easy letters. First they color it, then they read it!
Rocco the Little Monster Truck. Ages three to six. Link in bio!
